answer: Each identity holds a subleased berth at a working wharf, leased to a named holder. Each epoch the seed picks one container on that berth and demands a weighbridge ticket from the clerk: gross, tare, payload, sealed under a cipher whose key the seed derives, so last week's ticket decrypts to noise. Berths sharing a holder, terminal operator or scale serial fold into one vote. A berth runs $9,000 a year before clerk fees, so a thousand clones burn $9 million and need a thousand quays that do not exist. Quartz sand pours the same from any hopper; the scale remembers which wharf it crossed.
